purpose: Factual source inventory and independent implementation planning; no record authorizes execution.

license.note: Applies to WinUtil repository code; cataloged applications and external tools have their own licenses.

sourceSnapshots.inspection: PE version metadata only. No launch, instrumentation, or decompilation.
sourceSnapshots.sourceAvailability: No implementation source was available. Records describe intended effects only.

sourceSnapshots.inspection: Existing backend capability and module declarations inspected without running Windows actions. Concurrent implementation after this baseline is outside these coverage labels.

sourceSnapshots.role: Historical comparison only; these counts and coverage labels were not promoted to current-release facts.

evidenceLevels.source-confirmed: The pinned source declares the setting, action, target, or control. This is source inspection, not execution or a performance result.
evidenceLevels.binary-symbol-inferred: A named class, method, or property exists in printable strings of the pinned binary. Intended control is inferred; implementation and complete behavior are unverified.
evidenceLevels.binary-symbol-ambiguous: A generic command symbol is present but its owning surface and actual operation are unresolved.

safetyPolicy.rule: Use independent supported detectors and owned reversible or disposable executors. Every real registry/service/driver/uninstall/deletion action requires its exact authorization under repository instructions.

scopeCoverage.winutil: All entries in eight maintained config JSON files are accounted for; shared theme styling is metadata. All named interactive XAML controls are inventoried or classified as UI-only; CLI parameters and bundled media defaults are included. This is not an enumeration of every statement inside handler scripts or external tools.
scopeCoverage.gamingPlaybook: Every named setup choice, explicit no-browser choice, root YAML action, and task-phase YAML action is inventoried from the verified current archive. Embedded scripts are action-level records; their nested branches and bundled third-party programs are not represented as exhaustively known settings.
scopeCoverage.gamingToggles: Named toggles, commands, options and control labels are listed by their intended effect. The list cannot prove all visible controls, defaults, state transitions, or implementation behavior.
scopeCoverage.applicationPackages: WinUtil installable applications and AppX package entries are separate from optimizer settings. Playbook setup browser choices and AppX operation targets remain in their source option/action sections; the advertised toggles app downloader count is not treated as a source-confirmed per-package inventory.
